record.title: phishing wave incident retro
record.summary: The team conducted an incident retrospective for last week's phishing wave. The first click was reported at 09:14 and containment occurred at 09:52. Marcus identified a process gap where eleven minutes were lost waiting for him to leave a meeting, leading to the decision to create a documented escalation process that does not route through a single person. Regarding scope, 214 users received the email, 9 clicked, and 3 entered credentials; all three were reset within the hour with no successful attacker logins. Rio noted that the finance group still has an exemption from phishing-resistant MFA from the ERP migration two years ago. Since the ERP vendor supported FIDO keys as of their March release, the exemption will be removed via a config change and comms plan. Rio will stage this with a pilot of five finance users next week before rolling it out to the rest of the group. Priya has already added the phishing domains to the blocklist feed and sent a takedown request to the registrar. Rio suggested adding a canary token in the login footer template to detect clones immediately, which was added to the backlog. Marcus noted that users who reported the phishing received no acknowledgment, causing some to re-report; an auto-ack on the report button was also added to the backlog.
